narrative: OMX30 enters Wednesday on solid footing with broad global momentum (DAX +61bp, NASDAQ +66bp) and domestic technicals supporting a continuation of the bull regime (+8.8% above 200-MA, ROC-90 +6.3%). Yields declining sharply (US 10Y -138bp) and oil retreating 3% create a constructive backdrop: input cost relief for industrials, margin support for banks, and lower duration pressure on real estate. However, weak ADX (5.2) signals trend fragility—the rally lacks directional conviction, and RSI at 47.3 remains neutral with no overbought protection. At 99% of 52-week range and only 0.3% from highs, OMX30 faces mean-reversion risk if today's risk-on tone falters.
morningBrief: OMX30 poised for modest +0.3 to +0.5% open on global risk appetite and falling yields. DAX +61bp and NASDAQ +66bp provide constructive tone; oil's 3% drop relieves cost pressures on industrials and consumer. Watch Volvo B, Atlas Copco—weaker EUR/SEK and stable USD/SEK favour export narratives. Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken) should stabilize as 10Y yields stop collapsing; real estate (Balder, Castellum) benefits from refinancing relief. CRITICAL: ADX at 5.2 (weak) and price 0.3% from 52-week high demand discipline—any breakout failure risks mechanical selling. Boliden stands out as tactical long (copper +76bp, gold +120bp, direct commodity leverage). Key pivot 3123 (yesterday close); resistance 3180 (50-MA). Watch US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET for potential afternoon volatility.
